AboutPage.heading: An independent studio
AboutPage.paragraph1: OSIRIS is a small digital studio working with small and medium businesses in Croatia. There are no layers of management or handoffs between departments, you talk directly to the person working on your project.
AboutPage.paragraph2: That size is an advantage. Fewer meetings, less bureaucracy, more time spent on actual work. Every project gets full attention, not a fraction of time split across dozens of clients.
AboutPage.paragraph3: The focus stays the same: a website that looks professional, runs fast, and actually helps the business, whether that means a new site, a redesign, maintenance, or SEO.
